Legend

A mysterious Necromancer emerges and puts Tibia’s Dragons in danger.

Location

Greenshore, Pits of Inferno, Okolnir, Kha'zeel, Draconia.

Dangers

Dragons, Adventurer Group, Fatal Bug, Eldritch Dragon Lord, Ice Horror, The Gravedigger, Enthralled Dragons, Bonelords's Phylactery, Bone Overlord

Reward

One random Crypt Rune.

Click to show/hide the quest spoiler.
(settings)
Spoiler • edit


Method

Visit Draconia

Begin the quest by visiting S'Zallar M'Andar here (32702, 31594, 7).

hi > unrest > yes

You will receive a Jade Dragon Head. Travel to Draconia through Hellgate. Once on Draconia's surface, use the Jade Dragon Head to communicate with S'Zallar M'Andar. You should receive the following message:

You arrived. Great! Now investigate the Dragon Cemetery for a hint about what is going on there.

Go north to investigate Dragon Cemetery by going down the hole here (32814, 31562, 7) twice and speak with Dragon Ancestor Spirit.

hi > spirit

You learn that four ancestral dragons' spirits are being manipulated by someone. To free them, you need to seek out the places and relics to which their essences are bound.

Go back to S'Zallar M'Andar in Ab'dendriel to report the mission:

hi > mission

Adventurer Group

Battle recommendations:
Equip Energy Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Earth Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Fire Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Holy Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Ice Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Physical Damage Protection during this fight.

Requirements

  • Jade Dragon Head

Location

Greenshore (here (32269, 32125, 9)), entrance found here (32301, 32098, 7)

Boss mechanics

You will have to face five adventurers at once, each representing an available vocation. Upon reaching red health, they will turn into their avatar form, gaining higher damage protection and the ability to deal critical hits.

Adventurer Avatar Damage Type

Fiona Firstdream
Avatar of Storm		 Attacks from the distance
Fire Damage
Energy Damage

Grendel Greenlunch
Avatar of Nature		 Attacks from the distance
Earth Damage
Ice Damage

Percy Peacetinker
Avatar of Light		 Attacks from the distance
Physical Damage
Holy Damage

Yorik Youngbook
Avatar of Steel		 Attacks at melee range
Physical Damage

Nigel Neverguess
Avatar of Balance		 Attacks at melee range
Physical Damage

Boss room will also contain 3x Bright Crystal that explode with mana drain attack and apply a hex when attacked so it is important to avoid dealing damage to them.

When all adventurers are defeated, the final boss will appear: Fatal Bug.

After the fight

Enter a green teleport south of the room and use the Charred Skull.

BEWARE: You cannot use the green teleport to escape before the boss is defeated, even if you have previously completed the encounter.

We then report our progress by using the Jade Dragon Head, we should see the following message:

S'Zallar: That was only the first step. Now find the hidden hoard beneath the Plains of Havoc. Attune to the prize possession there while while having the jade talisman with you.

Eldritch Dragon Lord

Battle recommendations:
Don't use Fire Damage during this fight.
Use Ice Damage during this fight.
Equip Fire Damage Protection during this fight.

Requirements

  • Adventurer Group defeated and relic touched
  • Jade Dragon Head
  • Blood
  • Oil
  • The Holy Tible

Location

Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair (here (32755, 32308, 12))

Boss mechanics

There are 4x Pulsating Lavas, one in each corner of the room. After restoring enough health points, Pulsating Lava will transform into Eruption and then into Flame Totem. Each totem does AoE fire damage that heals the boss with range increasing with every stage. When Flame Totem is active, the Eldritch Dragon Lord takes reduced damage, and with at least 3 active totems, the boss becomes invulnerable. As the Eldritch Dragon Lord's health decreases, there will be times when Pulsating Lavas restore health and transform into Flame Totems. The goal of the fight is to keep at least 2 totems in their Pulsating Lava stage so the boss is vulnerable.

After the fight

Enter a green teleport south-west of the room and use the Molten Throne

BEWARE: You cannot use the green teleport to escape before the boss is defeated, even if you have previously completed the encounter.

We then report our progress by using the Jade Dragon Head, we should see the following message:

S'Zallar: Well done. Now seek the hoard in the deadly ice caves around the island of Okolnir. Attune to the prize possession there while while having the jade talisman with you.

Ice Horror

Battle recommendations:
Equip Ice Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Death Damage Protection during this fight.

Requirements

  • Eldritch Dragon Lord defeated and relic touched
  • Jade Dragon Head
  • Fire Bomb Rune

Location

Okolnir (here (32151, 31453, 7))

Boss mechanics

Beware of the frequent Rooted and Fear conditions during the fight. Use Fire Bomb Rune to deal with the Fear condition. Each player is also afflicted with a Drunk condition that cannot be removed.

Once in the boss room, players will be randomly targeted by cannons on the ship to the right. This is indicated by a red target effect left on the ground and the following message:

You are targeted!

Roughly 3 seconds after being targeted, a small AoE explosion will occur, damaging all creatures nearby and temporarily leaving a hole in the ice. Stepping onto a hole will freeze players and afflict them with a Rooted condition.

With this mechanic in mind, the first step is to use it to get past two Ice Blockades to the north. Position yourself near an Ice Blockade so that the explosions destroy it and create a passage. Additionally, Ice Crawlers will spawn occasionally along the way. Don't waste time killing them, as they are dealt with by the cannon mechanic.

Upon reaching the Ice Horror, it will initially be almost invulnerable, and party must use the cannon mechanic to damage it. When the boss reaches roughly half health, it spawns a large wave (approx. 20) of Ice Crawlers and becomes vulnerable to normal attacks. This is indicated by the following message The ice carpace breaks and the Ice Horror becomes vullnerable to ordinary attacks!

After the fight

Enter a green teleport north of the room and use the Draconic Rattle

BEWARE: After entering the green teleport, stop moving until the Drunk condition wears off to avoid accidentally leaving the room before using the Draconic Rattle.

BEWARE: You cannot use the green teleport to escape before the boss is defeated, even if you have previously completed the encounter.

We then report our progress by using the Jade Dragon Head, we should see the following message:

S'Zallar: Again you were successful. The last hoard is located in the Mountain that seperates destert and jungle in Darama. Attune to the prize possession there while while having the jade talsiman with you.

The Gravedigger

Battle recommendations:
Don't use Death Damage during this fight.
Use Earth Damage during this fight.
Equip Death Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Energy Damage Protection during this fight.

Requirements

  • Ice Horror defeated and relic touched
  • Jade Dragon Head
  • Dwarven Ring

Location

Ankrahmun Dragon Lair here (33049, 32683, 4), entrance found here (33095, 32690, 7)

Boss mechanics

  • Challenge does not work on the boss.
  • Each player's movement speed is decreased significantly.
  • Every 10 seconds 2x Bonelord Totems will spawn in the boss room at random positions replacing the old ones.
  • Bonelord Totems can afflict nearby players with a Drunk condition in a small AoE radius and a Rooted condition to players at melee range.
  • Every 30 seconds, a random wave will spawn going either from north to south or west to east. Each wave is 2 sqms wide and moves 1 sqm per second. Waves come in pairs separated by 5 sqms of free space. There are 4 possible variants of waves.
  • A player going through the wave will increase their stack count. Each stack increases damage taken. Getting a 21th stack causes instant death.
  • Gravedigger going through the wave will increase its stack count. Each stack increases its damage and reduces damage taken.

Wave variants

 Gravedigger Wave north-to-south variant 1


 Gravedigger Wave north-to-south variant 2


 Gravedigger Wave west-to-east variant 1


 Gravedigger Wave west-to-east variant 2

After the fight

Enter a green teleport south-east of the room and use the Gilded Wig.

BEWARE: You cannot use green teleport to escape before the boss is defeated, even if you previously completed the encounter.

We then report our progress by using the Jade Dragon Head, we should see the following message:

S'Zallar: You have attuned to all four ancients. Return to me in Ab'Dendriel and use my canoe to travel to the dragon cemetery again and confront the necromancer who is responsible for this atrocity.

Bone Overlord

Requirements

  • All previous bosses defeated
  • Fire Bomb Rune use suggested

Location

Below Draconia, in the Forgotten Crypt, here (32925, 31779, 11)

Boss mechanics

On the fight against the Bone Overlord, the goal is to destroy the Bonelords's Phylactery, but this Phylactery will only appear after all four Soulcages in the room are destroyed.

Throughout the whole fight, the Bone Overlord targets players (the targeted player will see a message: The bonelord gazes!) and triggers one of multiple additional mechanics:

Effect Message Description
THE BONELORD DISPLACES YOU! The target will be teleported to a separate room, where players must break these Bone Barriers (10,000 HP) to clear the path to the teleport that brings them back to the main room.
Since these barriers respawn, players can block the respawn point, causing them to spawn on a nearby position, which might not block the way.
AN EYE IS CAST ON YOU! An Eye will spawn near the target. After a few seconds, the Eye explodes in an area, dealing 20~30% of each player's maximum HP as Agony Damage.
Multiple Eyes can be summoned at the same time in the room.
THE BONELORD CASTS WRAITHFIRE AT YOU! Wraithfire will be cast under the target's feet. This deals 15% current HP as Agony Damage.
THE BONELORD DRAINS YOU! A Mana Drain over time is cast on the target, causing them to lose 5% maximum mana every 2 seconds, for 5 turns.
THE BONELORD CURSES YOU! A curse spell is cast on the target, which will cause them to explode in a small radius for Physical Damage every 4 seconds, for 4 turns.
This explosion can damage other players.

Phase 1: Soulcages

Battle recommendations:
Equip Death Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Energy Damage Protection during this fight.

Upon entering the room, four different Soulcages can be found, each linked to a different dragon Spirit and a different Special Condition that is randomly applied to all players in the room during the fight: Feared, Rooted, Slowed, and Drunk. Players must be aware and ready to handle any of these at any time during the fight. The dragon Spirits are one of the sources for these conditions, but not the only source.

The dragon Spirits are immune to all damage, but their Soulcages can be killed, and their HP pool is shared. It is important to not let a dragon Spirit near its Soulcage, or the Soulcage can heal up to 5,000+ per turn. At some points when the HP of the Soulcage is lowered, the linked dragon Spirit will teleport to it, making it harder to avoid the healing.

Soulcage Weaknesses Condition Teleport Position
North East
Zharvorin		 Death Damage
Physical Damage		 Rooted
North West
Myzareth		 Energy Damage Feared
South West
Scarith		 Ice Damage Drunk
South East
Elyrax		 Death Damage
Holy Damage		 Slowed


Phase 2: Bonelords's Phylactery

Battle recommendations:
Equip Life Drain Damage Protection during this fight.
Equip Death Damage Protection during this fight.

After destroying the soulcages, a Bonelords's Phylactery and 4 Enthralled Dragons will spawn south of the room. The dragons are not affected by Challenge spell and it is vital to equip life drain protection while facing them.

After the fight

Go back to S'Zallar M'Andar to report the progress on your mission, he will award you with one random Crypt Rune.

hi > mission > reward > yes

Furthermore, after the first use Jade Dragon Head will transform into Jade Dragon Head (Charged)

Transcripts

Visit Draconia

S'Zallar M'Andar: Human! The ancient spirits are in unrest.
Player: unrest
S'Zallar M'Andar: I have felt tremors in the spirit wind. Whispers, cold as moonlit stone, rising from the dragon graveyard. The ancestors there do not rest. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: Something stirs their ancient souls. Such unrest is not born without cause. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: I hunted the cause to its root, but the root lies beyond my reach. But here my travels came to an end. The source seems to be at a place that I can't visit, beyond a threshold I cannot cross. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: The dragon cemetery is a place most sacred. Its bones are heavy with ancient breath, and we, the scaled children, dare not tread upon that hallowed ground. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: To us, its silence is forbidden. Only echoes of wrath linger there. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: Yet shadows coil amidst the graves. Sinister forces stir, where none should dwell. Something desecrates the slumber of the old dragons. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: Are you willing to assist me in my quest and travel where the scaled children can't? Yes or no?
Player: yes
S'Zallar M'Andar: Take this totem. Through it, the elder spirits may heed your call, and through it, you may speak to me, wherever your steps may lead. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: It is a vessel of communion, a bridge across realms. Guard it well, for it is both your voice and mine. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: Should you misplace the totem, I may weave another. But every carving saps my strength and the essence of rare offerings. You must repay what is spent. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: Go, tread upon the bones of the mighty, and learn what disturbs the spirits of the old dragons. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: Before their wrath bleeds into our world.

The Roost of the Graveborn Quest

Dragon Ancestor Spirit: This one knows you came here for the disturbance of the spirit world!
Player: spirit
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: Listen, mortal. This one shall speak but once: ...
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: The spirits of the dragon graves whisper...
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: but their voices are broken, chained. This is the work of one who binds life and death alike. ...
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: Every great dragon bound its essence to a place, a hoard, a relic of its might. Seek these places, for only through their tokens may the spirits be freed and cleansed. ...
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: Even weakened by the relics, the graveborn will strike as storms of spirits and death. Do not mistake them for mere shadows of their former selves. ...
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: The puppeteer behind this desecration hides in bone and darkness. Deep beneath us, I feel his sinister doings! ...
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: He can only be defeated, if he is denied the souls he has stolen and bound. ...
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: The soul-essence of the ancients Myzareth, Zharvorin, Elyrax and Scarith is at stake. ...
Dragon Ancestor Spirit: Now leave! This one has spoken.

The Roost of the Graveborn Quest

S'Zallar M'Andar: Ah, the unscaled adventurer! I know, you are here to talk about our mission or have you lost your talisman?
Player: mission
S'Zallar M'Andar: You are now prepared to face the vile necromancer. Imbued with the souls of the ancients, you should be able to free them from whatever the necromancer has trapped them in. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: I prepared my canoe with ancient magic, to find its way through the spirit mists that shroud and protect the isle.. ...
S'Zallar M'Andar: If you are ready to face the threat, just ask me for a passage.
Player: passage
S'Zallar M'Andar: Do you want to use my canoe for a passage to draconia? Yes or no?
Player: Yes
S'Zallar M'Andar: Safe travels.

Player: ice
